headline: Sri Lanka revises down 2026 export revenue target to US$18.5bn from US$20bn
summary: Sri Lanka lowered its 2026 export revenue target to US$18.5 billion from US$20 billion. Exports grew 6% in the first ten months, below the expected 8%.
why: Export earnings determine Sri Lanka's foreign-exchange inflows, which matter for debt servicing and the rupee, given the country's external financing needs.
